responsibility: This header defines the `ampere1b_tunings` model for the Ampere-1B core variant in the AArch64 backend. In addition to its own prefetch settings, it provides Ampere-1B-specific AdvSIMD vector costs, a distinct vector-cost bundle, memory-move costs, issue rate, fusion mask, autoprefetcher strength, and tune flags, allowing instruction costing and tuning decisions to reflect the newer Ampere-1B microarchitecture rather than the base Ampere-1 family defaults.
